people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
translations.bsb: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her,
translations.asv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
